data.description:
## Context

Deferred non-blocking advisories from the fixture-heal work (ticket 1cef, epic R-4
`spin-cub-usher` / 65dd-e93b-666a-4caa). Each was dispositioned defer-followup during the
held-out close because it is non-blocking and the fail-closed/core paths are covered; they
are collected here so the trail is not dropped.

## Scope

`src/rebar/llm/evals/fixture_mining/heal.py`, `src/rebar/llm/evals/fixture_admission.py`,
`src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/ledger.py`, `docs/exit-codes.md`, and the heal/admission
unit tests.

## Deferred items to disposition

- [ ] Ledger spend double-count: `_run_admission` + `_record_spend` both write the same
      `ledger_path`, so per-admitted-criterion spend can be counted twice. Fail-closed and
      immaterial at cap 25 / est 0.5 with empty usage_rows today, but wrong once real
      per-case pricing lands.
- [ ] Real per-case usage pricing needs Bedrock-region model normalization (root of the
      423 fail-closed-via-estimate fix); until then usage_rows are empty.
- [ ] `ledger.charge_estimate` has no direct unit test; the `estimated: True` marker is
      unasserted.
- [ ] `_record_spend` `UnpriceableRun` fallback branch is untested (core fail-closed path
      is covered by the 423 loop test).
- [ ] BudgetExceeded FATAL disposition (actual overran estimate, next reserve raises, run
      stops with finalized admitted set) has no covering AC test.
- [ ] Consecutive-failure counter RESET path (criterion becomes covered / ticket closed ->
      counter zeroes) has no named AC test.
- [ ] `docs/exit-codes.md` is missing the `criteria heal [--dry-run]` exit contract.
- [ ] Perf: `_select_rows` / `_material_index` rebuild the corpus per criterion; O(criteria)
      full corpus reads.
- [ ] Perf: `ledger.reserve` re-parses the whole ledger per iteration, O(criteria x lines).
- [ ] Benign: an empty gap list still advances the due-stamp and returns ran=True.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Each item above is either fixed (with a covering test where it is a correctness or
      coverage gap) or explicitly accepted with a one-line reason recorded on this ticket.

## Budget

To be estimated when claimed.
